newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian dies of wounds sustained in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian dies of wounds sustained in clashes.

text.p: A Palestinian university student has died of wounds he sustained during gunbattles between PLO police and Israeli soldiers in September, Palestinian hospital officials said on Friday.
They said Yasser Abdel-Ghani al-Hamshari, 21, a second year student at Bir Zeit University's commerce department, died at the Ramallah hospital in the West Bank on Thursday night.

His death raised to 61 the number of Palestinians killed in the confrontations that erupted after Israel opened a tunnel near Moslem holy shrines in Jerusalem. Palestinians killed 15 Israelis in the clashes.
